name: Love Wife
overview: Scripture reveals that the love between husband and wife is a sacred bond established by God, where a man leaves his parents to unite with his wife as one flesh (Genesis 2:24). A wife is described as a good gift from the Lord, bringing favor to the husband (Proverbs 18:22). Husbands are called to love their wives sacrificially and tenderly, just as Christ loved the church and as they love their own bodies, avoiding bitterness (Ephesians 5:25, 28; Colossians 3:19). This love is to be mutual and self-giving, with wives also showing reverence to their husbands (Ephesians 5:33).
